command:
set -eu
proof_venv=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$proof_venv"' EXIT
python3 -m venv "$proof_venv"
"$proof_venv/bin/pip" --disable-pip-version-check install -r benchmark/region-overlay-proof/requirements.txt
python3 -c 'import datetime,json,socket,subprocess; print(json.dumps({"proof_started_at":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),"host":socket.gethostname(),"source":subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip()}),flush=True)'
"$proof_venv/bin/python" benchmark/region-overlay-proof/run.py < "$HOME/.local/state/ts-throwaway-account/f8-post23-20261105-proof.json"
